headline: 16 Bangladeshis killed in Saudi factory fire
summary: A devastating blaze at a sofa factory in Riyadh's Musa Industrial Area claimed the lives of at least 16 Bangladeshi nationals.
details: At least 16 Bangladeshi nationals were killed on the spot in a devastating fire at a sofa factory in Saudi Arabia.
The incident occurred around 2:00 pm yesterday in the Musa Industrial Area under the Al-Shifa police station in Riyadh.
According to a notification from the Expatriates' Welfare and Overseas Employment Ministry, all victims were Bangladeshi citizens.
Local fire services conducted rescue operations as the Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh expressed deep sorrow over the tragedy.
Embassy officials, including labour counsellor Rezae Rabbie, are working with Saudi authorities to identify the victims.
Earlier, Expatriates’ Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury stated that seven of the victims were from Naogaon’s Atrai upazila.

Embassy officials, including labour counsellor Rezae Rabbie, are working with Saudi authorities to identify the victims.

Earlier, Expatriates’ Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury stated that seven of the victims were from Naogaon’s Atrai upazila.

headline: 1 dead, 4 injured as covered van hits 2 bikes, auto-rickshaw in Moghbazar
summary: A speeding covered van lost control coming down from the Malibagh flyover, causing a fatal pileup near the Wireless Gate intersection on Sunday night.
details: At least one person was killed and four others injured after a covered van lost control and hit a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and two motorcycles in Dhaka’s Moghbazar Wireless Gate on Sunday night.
The victim, Zaman Ahmed, 42, of Narail Sadar upazila, was one of the motorcyclists, according to police.
The incident occurred around 11:30 PM in front of Grand Plaza Shopping Mall near the Wireless Gate intersection.
Sheikh Zahidul Islam, deputy commissioner of Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Ramna Division, stated that the covered van lost control while descending from the Malibagh flyover.
Five people were injured in the crash, one of whom later succumbed to their injuries. Two of the survivors remain in critical condition.
A witness, Kawsar Ahmed, 19, reported that the speeding van hit the vehicles from behind, forcing the auto-rickshaw and motorcycles into the divider.
caption:
A speeding covered van caused a fatal pileup in Moghbazar on Sunday night, leaving one dead and four injured.

At least one person was killed and four others injured after a covered van lost control and hit a CNG-run auto-rickshaw and two motorcycles in Dhaka’s Moghbazar Wireless Gate on Sunday night.

The victim, Zaman Ahmed, 42, of Narail Sadar upazila, was one of the motorcyclists, according to police.

The incident occurred around 11:30 PM in front of Grand Plaza Shopping Mall near the Wireless Gate intersection.

Sheikh Zahidul Islam, deputy commissioner of Dhaka Metropolitan Police's Ramna Division, stated that the covered van lost control while descending from the Malibagh flyover.

Five people were injured in the crash, one of whom later succumbed to their injuries. Two of the survivors remain in critical condition.

A witness, Kawsar Ahmed, 19, reported that the speeding van hit the vehicles from behind, forcing the auto-rickshaw and motorcycles into the divider.
